_about: J0 case list for reader E (CT_LSTV_CLASSIFIER_PLAN.md section 8): 20 CTs x 3 segmenters = 60 tasks. Every path verified on the grid login node 2026-09-24. Built by the scratch script select_j0.py from auto_reference/lists, readersAB/tables (reader A source_file = SPINEPS mask), fig6/frozen/auto_truth.csv (g3_side), transitional_registry (verse/screened.csv, registry.csv), positives_table.md section B, MAXIMIZE.md held list.

class_maps.note: readers A/B use the cobra copy for every corpus and state the three are md5-identical; reader C uses ~/bench/totalsegmentator/class_map.json; harvest_verse_census uses <ts_dir>/../class_map.json. All three exist (ls 2026-09-24); the J0 extractor should hash the one it loads into the JSON.

verse_ordinary_replaced.verse809: only ctd beside its SPINEPS mask is VERSE_verse809_ctd_isogrid.json (no plain _ctd.json); replaced by verse811
